release_name: Live TV v5.1.18 (Build 53) — Mobile Header Horizontal Swipe & Pro Polish
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 Mobile Header Smooth Swipe: The entire top header bar now glides horizontally with inertial touch scrolling on phones, allowing access to all 15+ tool buttons (EPG, Scores, Alarm, Bouquets, DVR, Kids, Multi-View, etc.)
✨ Compact Phone Header Optimization: Streamlined badge spacing and update indicators on narrow screens to maximize accessible feature tools upfront
⇄ Last Channel Recall (Q): Instant flashback toggle between current and previous channel
🎚️ Web Audio Lip-Sync Offset: Real-time delay compensation (-500ms to +1500ms)
🔍 In-Player Spotlight Channel Search (/): Instant modal HUD search across all 2,989+ channels without exiting fullscreen
🔔 Live Sports Match Reminders: Set alerts on upcoming matches with synthesized chime and 1-click tune
🔎 Custom Video Zoom & Pan: Multi-level zoom with touch pinch and drag-to-pan
↻ Stream Auto-Retry & Reconnect: 3-stage automatic stall recovery and instant reload
